_comment: TEMPLATE ONLY — do NOT use these values. Download your real google-services.json from the Firebase console (Project settings > Your apps > Android app with package com.digitalfootballalbum) and place it at app/android/app/google-services.json. The real file contains project keys and is gitignored (see app/.gitignore); this example is committed so the expected structure is documented. The com.google.gms.google-services Gradle plugin auto-applies only when google-services.json is present.
